“For the innocent that desires lethal protection at a low cost, and wants to hide their defensive power in a handbag or backpack, this year’s 27th re-release of the Fatality is now in stock!” - TV Advertisement

“It’s cheap, got burst fire, double-burst, enough ammo to last a few seconds, and it blows up sometimes. What else could you ask for from Budget ShitArms?” - Anonymous Arms Dealer

Cost: 50eb (Costly)

Class: PQ Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear]. If the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) when firing this weapon, it destroys itself beyond repair. If this occurs when using Autofire, the weapon also detonates in the user’s hand (After they resolve their Attack Check and damage), inflicting the Crushed Fingers Critical Injury to the hand wielding it. Users with a Cyberhand do not suffer the effect of Crushed Fingers, but do suffer its Bonus Damage. Incompatible with Smartgun Link and any Rebuild type.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
